reviews.comment:
Un lugar que parece estar detenido en el tiempo, pero no por eso quedó antiguo. Excelente la amabilidad de los empleados y la atención, muy surtido, limpio y prolijo. Recomiendo parar a conocer aunque no necesiten nada de lo que ofrecen.

(Translated by Google)
A place that seems frozen in time, but it's anything but outdated. The staff are incredibly friendly and attentive, the store has a great selection, and it's clean and tidy. I recommend stopping by even if you don't need anything they offer.
